name: CLUTRR
description: Compositional Language Understanding Test based on Relations and Reasoning. Designed to test compositional reasoning about relational structures and transitive logic. Tasks involve inferring relationships from structured descriptions.
reputation: Well-established benchmark for compositional and relational reasoning; particularly strong for testing systematic generalization
notes: Strong for testing compositional generalization and relational understanding. Useful for evaluating whether models learn systematic reasoning or pattern match training data.
